title: REQ · Scene clears focus on all objects when focusedObjectId is null
summary: A null focusedObjectId removes highlight and label from every SceneObject
description: Context: after focus was applied, the store may reset focusedObjectId to null (for example menu close). Desired behavior: BootScene blurs every focused SceneObject when the value is null. Expected result: no object keeps highlight or label. Why: stale highlights must not remain.
acceptance_criteria: Given a focused object and focusedObjectId changes to null, When onStateChange runs, Then blur() is called on that object
Given focusedObjectId is null and no object is focused, When onStateChange runs, Then no blur() call is made and nothing throws

preserve: Existing keyboard focus behavior in onKeyDown

technical_constraints: Use SceneObject.isFocused to decide whether to blur
definition_of_done: Null store focus clears scene focus
